payload.claim: The spec's "Size" paragraph reports a prototype measurement of 63 changed tokens outside the test paths. An independent prototype built from the same five steps measured 50 tokens via the actual `size_gate` module on a diff touching the same five production files. The discrepancy is almost certainly wording/whitespace choices between prototypes, and both figures are far under the 1300-token `bug` ceiling, so it has no bearing on the gate outcome or on `estimated_lines: 16`'s plausibility.
